item.title: Autonomous Weeder Robot
item.description: An autonomous robot that finds dandelions with machine vision, drives to them, and removes them mechanically. I led all work in software and autonomy.

item.title: Self-Driving Car Simulation
item.description: A simulated self-driving car with a PI cruise controller, a cascaded steering controller, a fuel-optimizing model predictive controller, and a lane-change state machine, cutting fuel use 18% while keeping a safe following distance.
